titleZh: 迅疾 ↔ 遲緩｜閃電對蝸牛
hook: 一邊 celerity／dispatch 像閃電快遞，一邊 bovine／drawl 像蝸牛開會——時鐘兩邊轉速不同。
script: celerity／expeditious／prompt／hasty 閃電隊。bovine／lethargic／dilatory／laggard 蝸牛隊。派件員：dispatch the package；別 bovine 在門口。

members.speakLineEn: With surprising celerity, the volunteer team cleared the hall after the concert.
members.speakLineZh: 志工隊以驚人的迅速，在音樂會後清出場地。

members.speakLineEn: She handled the ticket problems with quiet dispatch and got everyone seated.
members.speakLineZh: 她安靜又迅速地處理票務問題，讓大家都入座。

members.speakLineEn: An expeditious reply from the registrar saved him from missing the add deadline.
members.speakLineZh: 註冊組迅速回覆，讓他免於錯過加選截止日。

members.speakLineEn: A prompt apology after the misunderstanding calmed the whole group chat.
members.speakLineZh: 誤會後的即時道歉，讓整個群組聊天冷靜下來。

members.speakLineEn: A hasty conclusion from one rumor can hurt someone who never got a hearing.
members.speakLineZh: 根據一則謠言就草率下結論，可能傷害從未被聽取的人。

members.speakLineEn: The deer was fleet enough to vanish into the trees before anyone raised a camera.
members.speakLineZh: 那隻鹿速度夠快，在有人舉起相機前就消失進樹林。

members.speakLineEn: His bovine stare during the lecture suggested he had slept through the night before.
members.speakLineZh: 他課堂上那遲鈍如牛的眼神，暗示前一晚幾乎沒睡。

members.speakLineEn: Dilatory replies from the landlord delayed every repair in the student apartment.
members.speakLineZh: 房東磨蹭的回覆，拖延了學生公寓每一次維修。

members.speakLineEn: The last laggard finally caught up when the tour guide waited at the museum door.
members.speakLineZh: 導遊在美術館門口等候時，最後一個落後者終於趕上。

members.speakLineEn: Bullfrogs became lethargic with the first cold nights.
members.speakLineZh: 無精打採的，懶洋洋的。

related.antonyms: energetic, vivacious, active, dynamic, industrious, diligent

members.speakLineEn: After lunch the class felt sluggish until someone opened the windows for air.
members.speakLineZh: 午餐後全班感覺遲緩，直到有人開窗換氣。

members.speakLineEn: If you dawdle in the hallway, you will miss the first five minutes of chemistry.
members.speakLineZh: 若在走廊混日子閒晃，你會錯過化學課前五分鐘。

members.speakLineEn: He tended to drawl each vowel when telling stories about his hometown summers.
members.speakLineZh: 講起家鄉夏天故事時，他常慢吞吞地拉長每個母音。

members.speakLineEn: Security asked teens not to loiter near the station exit after midnight.
members.speakLineZh: 保全要求青少年午夜後不要在車站出口附近閒逛。

related.synonyms: lounge, footle, lollygag, loaf, lallygag, tarry

members.speakLineEn: A flash of lightning lit the dorm courtyard during the sudden evening storm.
members.speakLineZh: 突如其來的晚間暴風雨中，一道閃電照亮宿舍中庭。

members.speakLineEn: A tiny snail left a shiny trail across the wet chalkboard eraser tray.
members.speakLineZh: 一隻小蝸牛在潮濕的黑板擦托盤上留下亮亮的痕跡。

members.speakLineEn: The mailroom held a package of books that arrived too late for the reading week.
members.speakLineZh: 收發室扣留了一包書，可惜來得太晚趕不上閱讀週。

members.speakLineEn: Our project meeting moved to the quiet room beside the library stairs.
members.speakLineZh: 我們的專題會議改到圖書館階梯旁的安靜房間。

members.speakLineEn: The mechanic explained how a turbo forces more air into the small engine.
members.speakLineZh: 技師解釋渦輪如何把更多空氣壓進小型引擎。

members.speakLineEn: She pressed the brake gently as the school bus approached the icy corner.
members.speakLineZh: 校車接近結冰轉角時，她輕輕踩下煞車。

members.speakLineEn: He saved one final sprint for the last fifty meters of the charity race.
members.speakLineZh: 慈善路跑最後五十公尺，他留下衝刺力氣衝刺。
